cohort: A total of 27 pregnant women were initially examined pre-labor, with 7 of these women subsequently examined during the second stage of labor.
finding: Fetal head molding and associated brain shape changes were systematically observed during the second stage of labor, with most cranial deformation resolving after birth.
mod_finding: Among the three fetuses with the greatest skull molding and brain shape deformation, two were delivered by cesarean-section while one was born physiologically.
